queries: WITH t AS (SELECT ra.name, SUM(r.points) AS total, SUM(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS laps_sum, COUNT(r.laps) AS laps_cnt FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ra.name IN (SELECT name FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total)) AS avg_laps_completed, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: Total points per race name is the sum of results.points across all years and results rows for that race name; the average is taken across race names (each name counted once).
Average laps completed is the average of results.laps over all result rows (driver entries) belonging to the qualifying race names, not an average of per-race-name averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Average laps completed computed as the average of each qualifying race name's own average laps (each race name weighted equally).
